extensionDescription.message: Clears stale browser data from sites you no longer visit.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension shown in the add-on store and manager.

popupOptionsButton.description: Button in the popup header that opens the options page.

popupSkipReminder.description: Button shown while a cleaning reminder is due; dismisses it and restarts the timer without cleaning.

popupReminderBanner.message: Time to clean — it's been over $DAYS$ days since the last clean.
popupReminderBanner.description: Context banner shown in the popup while a cleaning reminder is due; $DAYS$ is the configured reminder interval.

popupReminderSkipped.message: Reminder skipped — the next one comes in $DAYS$ days.
popupReminderSkipped.description: Confirmation after the user skips a due reminder; $DAYS$ is the configured reminder interval.

reminderNotificationMessage.message: Time to clean stale browsing data. Open Stale Cookie to review and delete.
reminderNotificationMessage.description: Body of the optional system notification reminding the user to clean.

popupScanButton.description: Button in the popup that starts a scan (preview, nothing is deleted). Says "browsing data", not "cookies" — the scan covers cookies, history and downloads.

popupNoScanYet.description: Placeholder status shown in the popup before the first scan.

popupScanning.description: Status shown while a scan is in progress.

sectionStale.description: Heading of the list of stale sites; $COUNT$ is the number of sites.

sectionUnknown.description: Heading of the list of sites with no recorded visit; preselection follows the never-visited policy.

summaryFreshProtected.description: Summary line for sites that are not shown in the lists.

cookieCount.description: Number of cookies in a site group.

historyCount.description: Number of history entries in a site group.

downloadCount.description: Number of download history entries in a site group.

lastVisit.description: Last visit date of a site, shown next to the cookie count.

partitionedBadge.description: Badge on third-party cookies partitioned under another site.

partitionedUnder.description: Tooltip explaining which top-level site a partitioned cookie belongs to.

protectButton.description: Per-site button that adds the site to the whitelist.

protectedToast.description: Feedback after a site was added to the whitelist from the preview.

protectedUndo.description: Button next to the protected-site feedback that removes the site from the whitelist again.

deleteButton.description: Button that deletes the selected rows' data; $COUNT$ is the total item count across data types, $SITES$ the number of selected sites.

popupDeleteConfirm.message: Delete the selected data ($COUNT$ items)? Cookies can be restored for the next 24 hours while the browser stays open; deleted history and downloads cannot be recovered.
popupDeleteConfirm.description: Inline confirmation message shown before deleting the selected preview rows. Must stay faithful to the undo bounds: cookie snapshot expires after 24 h or on browser close, one deletion deep; history/downloads are never restorable.

popupConfirmDeleteButton.description: Button that confirms the pending deletion.

popupCancel.description: Button that dismisses the pending deletion confirmation.

popupFailed.message: Something went wrong. Details are in the error log (Settings → Logs).
popupFailed.description: Status shown in the popup when a scan or deletion fails unexpectedly.

popupUndoButton.description: Button that undoes the last deletion by re-creating the snapshotted cookies. Cookies only — history and downloads cannot be restored.

popupUndoDetail.message: Deleted $WHEN$ · restorable until $UNTIL$ while the browser stays open.
popupUndoDetail.description: Detail line under the restore button: when the snapshotted deletion happened and when the undo window closes. Must stay faithful to the undo bounds (24 h, browser session).

popupRestoredToast.description: Status shown after an undo finished.

scanSummary.message: Found $STALE$ stale sites and $UNKNOWN$ with no recorded visit.
scanSummary.description: Status line after a scan, also announced to screen readers.

allClean.description: Positive status shown when a scan finds data but none of it is stale or never-visited.

emptyState.description: Status shown when a scan finds no data of any enabled type at all.

optionsTypesTitle.description: Heading of the data type / threshold section.

optionsTypesHint.message: Checked types are included in the scan. A site's data counts as stale after this many days without a visit.
optionsTypesHint.description: Explanation under the data types heading.

typeCookies.description: Data type row label: cookies (always cleaned, cannot be unchecked).

typeHistory.description: Data type row label: browsing history.

typeDownloads.description: Data type row label: download history (the log, not the files).

optionsDaysLabel.description: Unit shown after each staleness threshold input.

optionsPermissionDenied.message: The browser permission was declined, so this stays off.
optionsPermissionDenied.description: Shown when the user declines an optional permission request.

optionsThresholdWarning.message: Cookies are set to outlive browsing history. Once a site's history is deleted, its remaining cookies will show as "no visit recorded" in later scans.
optionsThresholdWarning.description: Warning shown when the cookie threshold is larger than the history threshold.

optionsAutoTitle.description: Heading of the automatic (scheduled) cleaning section.

optionsAutoHint.message: Cleans in the background without a preview: stale data is deleted, protected sites are never touched, and sites with no recorded visit follow the setting above. Everything deleted is recorded in the action log.
optionsAutoHint.description: Explanation under the automatic cleaning heading.

optionsAutoDaysLabel.description: Label of the automatic cleaning interval input.

optionsReminderAutoNote.message: Automatic cleaning is on, so the manual cleaning reminder is disabled.
optionsReminderAutoNote.description: Note shown over the grayed-out reminder controls while automatic cleaning is enabled.

optionsReminderTitle.description: Heading of the reminder section on the options page.

optionsReminderDaysLabel.message: Remind me to clean after this long without cleaning:
optionsReminderDaysLabel.description: Label of the reminder interval input.

optionsReminderBadgeLabel.description: Checkbox for the default reminder vehicle (toolbar badge).

optionsReminderNotificationLabel.description: Checkbox for the optional secondary reminder vehicle (needs the notifications permission).

optionsGlobalTitle.description: Heading of the global clear section.

optionsGlobalHint.message: Cache and saved form data cannot be cleaned per site, so this clears ALL of it — every site, recently visited or not. There is no preview.
optionsGlobalHint.description: Warning under the global clear heading.

optionsGlobalFormData.description: Global clear checkbox: saved form autofill data.

optionsGlobalButton.description: Button that starts the global clear (first click arms a confirmation).

optionsGlobalConfirm.message: This will clear ALL selected data — every site, recently visited or not. Continue?
optionsGlobalConfirm.description: Confirmation dialog shown before executing the global clear.

optionsGlobalDone.description: Status after a global clear finished.

optionsUnknownTitle.description: Heading of the options section governing preselection of never-visited sites.

optionsKeepUnknownLabel.message: Never preselect cookies from sites with no recorded visit
optionsKeepUnknownLabel.description: Checkbox that stops never-visited sites from being preselected for deletion.

optionsKeepUnknownHint.message: When off, these cookies are preselected for deletion — unless the scan finds no visit data at all, in which case nothing is preselected. You can always change the selection before deleting.

optionsConfigTitle.description: Heading of the settings import/export section.

optionsConfigHint.message: Save your settings to a JSON file, or load one exported from another profile. The file never leaves your computer.

optionsExportButton.description: Button that downloads the current settings as a JSON file.

optionsImportButton.description: Label of the file input that loads a settings export.

optionsImportInvalid.message: This file is not a Stale Cookie settings export.
optionsImportInvalid.description: Error shown when the imported file cannot be parsed as a settings export.

optionsImportDone.description: Status after a successful settings import.

optionsImportPermissionNote.message: Some imported options need browser permissions and were turned off — re-enable them above to grant access.
optionsImportPermissionNote.description: Appended to the import status when permission-gated options were disabled because their permission is missing in this profile.

optionsLogsTitle.description: Heading of the logs section (action log + session error log).

optionsLogsHint.message: The action log records what the extension deleted. Errors from this browser session are kept in memory only and disappear when the browser closes. Nothing here leaves your computer unless you export it.

optionsActionLogTitle.description: Subheading of the action log list; $COUNT$ is the number of entries.

optionsErrorLogTitle.description: Subheading of the session error list; $COUNT$ is the number of entries.

optionsActionLogEmpty.description: Empty state of the action log list.

optionsErrorLogEmpty.description: Empty state of the session error list.

logDeletedCookies.description: Action log line for a cookie deletion.

logDeletedHistory.description: Action log line for a history deletion.

logDeletedDownloads.description: Action log line for a download history deletion.

logRestoredCookies.description: Action log line for an undo (cookie restore).

logGlobalClear.description: Action log line for a global clear; $TYPES$ lists the cleared data types.

optionsLogsAnonymize.description: Checkbox that pseudonymizes site names and strips URLs in the exported log file.

optionsLogsAnonymizeHint.message: Replaces every site with a placeholder like site-1.example (the same site always gets the same placeholder) and strips URLs from error messages. Recommended when attaching logs to a bug report.

optionsLogsExportButton.description: Button that downloads both logs as a JSONL file.

optionsWhitelistHint.message: Cookies from these sites are never deleted.

optionsWhitelistInvalid.message: This doesn't look like a valid domain.
optionsWhitelistInvalid.description: Shown when the whitelist input can't be normalized to a registrable domain.

optionsWhitelistDuplicate.description: Shown when the whitelist input normalizes to a domain already on the list.

optionsNumberInvalid.message: Enter a whole number of days between 1 and 3650.
optionsNumberInvalid.description: Shown next to a days input holding an invalid value; the invalid value is not saved.

optionsAdd.description: Button that adds a domain to the whitelist.

optionsRemove.description: Button that removes a domain from the whitelist.

optionsSaved.description: Brief confirmation after settings are stored.
